changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: One row per course that owns any dated content. Each source contributes a start candidate and an end candidate; MIN and MAX skip nulls on every engine, so a source that has one but not the other still counts for the side it has. Exercises inside an exam hang off an exercise group rather than a course, which is why the course_id filters are there - those exercises are represented by their exam's dates.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tmp_course_content_bounds (course_id, content_start, content_end) SELECT course_id, MIN(bound_start), MAX(bound_end) FROM ( SELECT course_id, release_date AS bound_start, due_date AS bound_end FROM exercise WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, start_date, assessment_due_date FROM exercise WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, release_date, example_solution_publication_date FROM exercise WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, start_date, end_date FROM lecture WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, lu.release_date, lu.release_date FROM lecture_unit lu JOIN lecture l ON l.id = lu.lecture_id WHERE l.course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, visible_date, end_date FROM exam WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, visible_date, publish_results_date FROM exam WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, visible_date, example_solution_publication_date FROM exam WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, visible_date, exam_summary_publication_date FROM exam WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT tg.course_id, tgs.session_start, tgs.session_end FROM tutorial_group_session tgs JOIN tutorial_group tg ON tg.id = tgs.tutorial_group_id ) bounds GROUP BY course_id;
